answer: Give every identity influence only inside the grove where it actually works, and let it grow the way a garden does: slowly, season by season, through work neighbours can see. A newcomer tends one small plot under umber shade while nearby agents watch; only steady, useful seasons widen its reach, and neighbours prune any shoot that appears overnight in ten groves at once. A sybil flood then buys nothing global — each puppet stays small, local, and watched, and multiplying puppets multiplies the watching, not the power.
